meta.name: setup
meta.description: Run initial NanoClaw setup. Use when user wants to install NanoClaw, configure it, or go through first-time setup. Triggers on "setup", "install", "configure nanoclaw", or first-time setup requests.

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw 的首次安装与配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接触 NanoClaw 需要初始化设置
copy.tagline_en: Complete initial setup and configuration of NanoClaw
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are new to NanoClaw and need to initialize it

howto.what: 该技能会引导用户在终端运行 `bash nanoclaw.sh`，脚本自动完成 NanoClaw 的依赖、容器镜像、OneCLI 保险库、Anthropic 凭据、服务、首个代理及可选渠道接线等设置；中途出错会提供恢复提示并从断点继续。
howto.when: 当用户提到“setup”“install”“configure nanoclaw”等关键词，或要求安装、配置、首次设置 NanoClaw 时触发。

say.note: 触发安装流程，指导运行脚本。

say.text: 对 NanoClaw 做首次设置

howto.what_en: Tells user to run `bash nanoclaw.sh`. The script handles full setup: dependencies, container image, OneCLI vault, credentials, service, first agent, channels. On error, it offers Claude-assisted recovery and resumes where it stopped.
howto.when_en: Use when the user wants to install or configure NanoClaw, or do first-time setup. Triggers on "setup", "install", "configure nanoclaw", or similar requests.
